content.text:
h01.

**S3 presign runner — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:169`** (also runs once at startup on `server/server.go:163`).

Details:
- **Component:** `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`. Its `CheckAndPresign` method walks all S3-stored attachments in batches and re-generates presigned GET URLs, storing the fresh URL back on each attachment (`runner.go:47-132`). This keeps the externally-stored (S3) attachment links from expiring — presigned URLs are set to expire in 5 days, and it refreshes any that are within 4 days of the last presign (`runner.go:85-91`).
- **Schedule:** every 12 hours, driven by a `time.Ticker` with `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, `29-41`).
- **Wiring at startup:** in `server/server.go`, the runner is constructed at line 162, run once immediately at line 163, then started as a background goroutine whose ticker loop is entered at `server/server.go:169` (`s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)`).
